name: Remote GPU servers
description: gpu run on configured ssh / Slurm servers (--sync/--fetch/--stage/--env), node staging, NAS mirror
help: gpu run --gpu <server-id|auto> [--sync DIR] [--fetch out] [--stage a,b] [--env NAME] -- <command>   jobs on gpu.servers   (plugin remote-gpu)
nas push <dir...> | where <path> | ls [dir]   mirror code/data to the cluster NAS (config nasMirror)   (plugin remote-gpu)
